content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely temporary engagement in extramural funded project under UP (R&D) Initially for 4 months; may be extended or curtailed depending on project requirement and performance or conduct Tenure co-terminus with the project; never beyond project duration Performance reviewed periodically; anyone not up to the mark could be terminated Position confers no claim on any post in CSJMU

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 18 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CSJMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 18 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department of Lifelong Learning and Extension, CSJMU, Kanpur.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years (as on date of Walk-in-Interview). Relaxation: Upper age limit relaxable as per the Government of India Rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 15000 (emoluments).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's in social discipline (Humanities/Sciences) with 55% marks; NET/M.Phil/Ph.D. desirable.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Upper age limit is relaxable as per Government of India Rules.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary engagement in extramural funded project under UP (R&D). Initially for 4 months; may be extended or curtailed depending on project requirement and performance or conduct. Tenure co-terminus with the project; never beyond project duration.
